seoTitle: Contact GT Marketing | Start a Marketing Project in Darwin
seoDescription: Start a marketing project with GT Marketing in Darwin. Tell us what you need and we’ll respond with the most practical next step.

hero.intro: Tell us what you’re trying to achieve. We’ll help turn the right marketing strategy, creative and digital channels into a clear next move.
hero.responseNote: Prefer direct contact? Call or email us — no long brief required.

form.heading: Tell us what you need.
form.intro: Keep it simple. Share the goal, challenge or opportunity and we’ll come back with the most practical next step.
form.needLabel: What would you like help with?
form.needPlaceholder: For example: more leads, a new website, Google Ads, SEO, social media, a campaign, or a complete marketing system.

process.title: We review
process.text: We look at your goal, business context and what you actually need — not just what service you selected.

process.title: We clarify
process.text: If needed, we have a short conversation to define priorities, scope and the most useful next step.

process.title: We move
process.text: You receive a clear recommendation or proposal covering deliverables, timing and fees.
